scope: Theorem 2.1 of the manuscript “A Three-Manifold Without Conjugate Points and Without a Nonpositively Curved Metric” (preprints/A-Three-Manifold-Without-Conjugate-Points-and-Without-a-Nonpositively-Curved-Metric-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 358 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0ac6d8b58c960941), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The fundamental group Γ = π1(M) of the closed three-manifold defined by (2.1) admits no proper cocompact isometric action on a nonempty proper CAT(0) space.
